project_title: Racontelle Family Memory App - Member Profile & Memories Enhancement

theme.description: Warm, nostalgic, family-heritage aesthetic with soft cream backgrounds, vintage muted terracotta/rose accents, sage green secondary highlights, and elegant serif typography (Cormorant Garamond) combined with clean sans-serif (DM Sans).

rules.headings: Use Cormorant Garamond / CormorantSemiBold for high emotional storytelling hierarchy (Titles, Member Names, Section Headers)
rules.body: Use DM Sans / DMSansMedium for maximum legibility on mobile screens (Stats, Timestamps, Descriptions, Form labels)
rules.max_heading_size: 32px on mobile to avoid layout breaking
rules.hierarchy: Header 24px-28px Cormorant, Subtitle 16px DMSansMedium, Card Label 12px uppercase tracking-wider

layout_and_spacing.container_padding: 16px horizontal, 24px vertical with safe area insets consideration

profile_section_rules.active_members_grid: Horizontal scroll or 2-column grid of active family members with avatar, initial color badge, total memories badge, and total recorded duration
profile_section_rules.member_card: Card container with background #F5F2EB, subtle border #EBE6DC, rounded 16px, click feedback touchable ripple/opacity
profile_section_rules.member_detail_sheet: Mobile-optimized modal or full screen showing member bio badge, total recorded duration formatted in hours/minutes (e.g., '1h 45 min' or '12 min'), total memories count, and chronological list of memories with direct navigation to memory detail

active_family_members_section.title: Membres de la famille
active_family_members_section.description: Displays only active profile members in the Profile tab. Shows clickable avatar cards displaying total recorded memories and total audio duration.

member_detail_modal_or_screen.location: app/members/[id].tsx or modal bottom sheet in profile
member_detail_modal_or_screen.description: Fiche membre mobile containing summary metrics (number of memories, total recording duration), chronological timeline of audio/text memories, and click-through to memory detail (e.g. /capsule/[id]).

member_management_navigation.description: Quick link button to manage all members ('Gérer les membres')

vintage_family_1.description: Family photos sheet background for memory album

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_rules: All interactive buttons, member cards, memory list items, toggles, inputs, and text counts MUST contain explicit data-testid or testID attributes matching kebab-case convention.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for body text against warm background #FDFBF7

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always preserve existing warm Racontelle design tokens (#FDFBF7 surface, #C98B8B brand rose, #738A70 sage green, Cormorant font for titles).
Active family profiles only must be listed in the Profile screen section.
Clicking a family member card must open their detailed profile sheet/view displaying total memory count, total recording duration formatted clearly, and chronological list of memories.
Each memory item in the member's list must be tap-navigable to the detail screen (/capsule/[id] or equivalent detail route).
Maintain complete data-testid attributes for automated testing.
